title: Founding Qa / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, Ai + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.

We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.

Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.

We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.

Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.

We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.

We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.

This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.

The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires

What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale

Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss

Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems

Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments

Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.

Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration

Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person

Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.

Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome

If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

Você combina pensamento estratégico e execução prática, sendo capaz de traduzir metas em planos claros e realizáveis.   • Familiaridade com os principais segmentos industriais da região.

Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass);
seguro de vida;
cooperativa de crédito;
previdência privada;

Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.

Por que um Banco de Talentos afirmativo para Pessoas com Deficiência?

POSITION SPECIFICATION

ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.

Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws.   • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

title: Remote Ai Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Coordenador De Banco De Dados
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!

Sobre a área:

  • Lidar com diversos fornecedores de produtos e serviços que atendem a disciplina de Banco de Dados acompanhando, gerindo e cobrando ações quando necessário.
  • Interagir com as áreas pares para entender e endereçar demandas, novos projetos, problemas, duvidas e reclamações a respeito do ambiente de Bando de Dados.

  • Assegurar o uso otimizado dos recursos tecnológicos da plataforma através da análise das métricas de capacidade dos bancos de dados;
  • Planejar, elaborar e executar projetos de infraestrutura de Banco de Dados liderando equipes heterogêneas afim de otimizar e maximizar a performance de cada indivíduo além de atender as novas demandas das áreas de negócio;
  • Implantar recursos de bancos de dados para capacitar o ambiente a suportar crescimentos e demandas de negócio mesmo que ainda não mapeadas;
  • Apoiar, instruir e direcionar o time técnico afim de sanar dúvidas, questões técnicas ou processuais a respeito da disciplina de Banco de Dados;
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão e vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas;

Principais atividades:

  • Supervisionar e acompanhar a disciplina de Banco de Dados, participando de projetos e crises, contribuindo e orientando os seus liderados na forma de atuar e ser um facilitador nas interfaces com as outras disciplinas tanto de Operações, Engenharia de Infraestrutura e Engenharia de Desenvolvimento.
  • Acompanhar, validar e medir a qualidade e saúde do ambiente de Banco de Dados.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar os indicadores da area de Banco de Dados.
  • Tracionar iniciativas de automação para a gestão do ambiente de Banco de Dados, reduzindo atividades operacionais e garantindo agilidade e tempo de resposta as mudanças de ambiente.
  • Contribuir para obter um clima organizacional favorável, bem como a redução do turn over, através de ferramentas de gestão de pessoas, como contratações assertivas, comunicação interna eficaz, treinamento e desenvolvimento, reconhecimento e recompensa, buscando equipes de alta performance.
  • Zelar pelo sigilo das informações tratadas na sua área de atuação.
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas. Liderar um time de Banco de Dados com diversas stacks de Banco de Dados tanto onpremises quanto em Cloud.

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Experiencia em gestão de pessoas
  • Habilidade de construir matriz de decisão, RFPs e RFIs
  • Experiencia de gestão financeira e de contratos de infraestrutura de TI
  • Conhecimento Avançado de banco de dados SQL Server
  • Conhecimento de Bancos Nativos Cloud
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados My SQL (Desejável)
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados No SQL (Desejável)
  • Cursos e certificações correlatas a Banco de dados

Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

- Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

- Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

- Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

- Identifiquem eantecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

- Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

- Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.

title: Senior Endpoint Security Automation Engineer
description:

The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. This role plays a critical part in improving detection-to-response time, enhancing operational visibility, and ensuring scalable and resilient endpoint security operations.

Design, implement, and maintain automated workflows for endpoint security event and issue management.

Integrate endpoint detection platforms with ServiceNow for automated ticket creation, enrichment, prioritization, and lifecycle management.

Develop dashboards and executive-level reporting using Microsoft Power BI to provide actionable security insights and KPIs.

Orchestrate data pipelines and security telemetry ingestion Data Hub or equivalent data integration technologies.

Design and optimize SIEM use cases and correlation rules to enhance endpoint threat detection.

Develop and maintain SOAR playbooks to automate triage, containment, remediation, and escalation processes.

Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, Endpoint Engineering, and IT Operations teams to continuously improve automation and security processes.

Ensure proper documentation of automation workflows, integrations, and operational procedures.

Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing manual effort and increasing response efficiency.

Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior team members.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).

5+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, with strong focus on endpoint security.

Proven experience integrating and automating workflows within ServiceNow.

Hands-on experience building reports and dashboards in Microsoft Power BI.

Experience working with data orchestration platforms such as Data Hub.

Strong experience with SIEM platforms (e.G.,Sentinel).

Hands-on experience with SOAR platforms and playbook development.

Solid understanding of endpoint security tools (EDR/XDR) or BeyondTrust

Experience with scripting and automation (e.G., Python, PowerShell, REST APIs).

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field;
    postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills;
    fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment

Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.Js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.Js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.

You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.

You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.Js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.G., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.Js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.Js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S.
-Based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.

  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.

Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload

Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.G., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data;
    partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks;
    contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.G., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understandingof scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Product Owner Pleno (Po)

  • Monitorar métricas de produto e comportamento do usuário;
  • Utilizar dados para validar hipóteses e apoiar decisões de produto;
  • Conduzir experimentos (A/B tests, testes de solução, validações rápidas).

  • Experiência com métricas de produto digital.

Diferenciais:

  • Noções de arquitetura e stacks de tecnologia (backend, web, app, infraestrutura);
  • Experiência em varejo, e-commerce ou marketplaces;
  • Experiência em startups;
  • Experiência com prototipação rápida e ferramentas de construção low-code / IA.

O que esperamos dessa pessoa:

  • Forte orientação a resolver problemas reais dos usuários ;
  • Mentalidade data-driven ;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões com autonomia e responsabilidade ;
  • Perfil mão na massa , confortável em testar soluções rapidamente;
  • Curiosidade eabertura para trabalhar com IA e novas ferramentas de construção de produto ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares.

O que você pode esperar dos Supers?

  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;

O que oferecemos:

  • Incentivo ao desenvolvimento: estamos comprometidos com a excelência e o aprendizado contínuo. Oferecemos avaliações semestrais, conversas de one-on-one, feedbacks construtivos, e muito mais.

E aí, vamos juntos nesse SuperFoguete?

title: Customer Success Coordinator/Account Manager
description:
Company Description

Headshots.Com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology. As we scale our platform, strong delivery discipline and cross-functional coordination are critical.

Headshots.Com is seeking a Customer Success Coordinator to support post-launch customer engagement, account coordination, and internal systems upkeep. This role helps ensure a smooth, high-quality experience for customers through consistent execution and strong coordination across teams.

The ideal candidate brings a high level of organization, reliability, and comfort working at the intersection of customer communication, systems accuracy, and cross-functional team collaboration.

Core Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Account Support

  • Conduct monthly check-ins with launched teams to maintain engagement, gather feedback, and surface potential expansion or upsell opportunities.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned team accounts after launch, handling questions, updates, and general account support.
  • Escalate complex issues or commercial conversations to senior leadership as needed.

Training & Enablement Support

  • Lead or co-lead admin and team training sessions on how to submit usable photos (lighting, framing, attire, common errors).
  • Manage live Q&A during trainings using prepared materials and documented best practices.
  • Capture recurring questions and feedback to improve documentation and training assets over time.

Account Management & Operational Advocacy

  • Serve as a coordination point across Customer Success, Production, and internal teams to ensure customer uploads and deliverables move smoothly through established workflows.
  • Maintain regular update cadences and ensure files, approvals, and records are accurately tracked and archived.
  • Act as an advocate for both customers and internal teams by identifying process gaps, reducing friction, and surfacing opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define requirements and support the transition from manual tracking to more scalable, automated systems over time.

CRM & Data Hygiene (Pipedrive)

  • Keep Pipedrive records current for organizations and deals, ensuring required fields are completed for reporting, visibility, and handoffs.
  • Flag repeat manual work that should be automated and document requirements clearly for Dev.

Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal English language skills
  • 3+ years in customer success, operations, or administrative support.
  • 2+ years of sales experience.
  • Strong written communication and customer-facing professionalism.
  • Experience working with CRMs (Pipedrive, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Comfortable coordinating across Customer Success, Production, Sales, and Dev.
  • Highly organized, dependable, and able to follow recurring cadences.

Preferred

  • Experience running customer trainings or onboarding sessions.
  • Familiarity with SaaS-style account management or subscription services.
  • Process documentation or SOP experience.

Why This Role Matters

This position is not just support—it is a force multiplier. By owning recurring customer and data workflows, this role directly enables Headshots.Com to scale accounts, improve retention, and transition from manual effort to system-driven growth.

IMPORTANT

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.Com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

title: Llm Application Engineer
description:
The Role

You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.

We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.

.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources
  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection
  • Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications
  • Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems
  • Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available
  • Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically
  • Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.

What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience):

  • Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.
  • Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it
  • Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar
  • Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management
  • Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)
  • Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging
  • Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)

Nice to have:

  • Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)
  • Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings
  • Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services
  • Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric , Power BI , or Azure ecosystem

Why This Role

  • Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.
  • Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.
  • Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.
  • Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

title: Sdet Engineer (Req. English)
description:
Fetchly is seeking a highly skilled Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our engineering team. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain automated tests for our consumer-facing web applications, internal tools, and services. You will help modernize our end-to-end testing ecosystem by creating new Playwright-based test suites and migrating legacy Cypress tests into our new automation framework. This role is ideal for someone who loves building robust automation, improving engineering velocity, and partnering closely with developers to ship high-quality software.
Responsibilities
  1. Develop scalable and maintainable test automation for web applications and APIs using Playwright.
  2. Convert and modernize existing Cypress test suites into Playwright, including both end-to-end tests and smoke tests.
  3. Collaborate with software engineers to ensure test coverage, quality standards, and automation best practices across the stack.
  4. Work with applications built on Next.Js (front-end), NestJS (back-end), and AWS cloud services.
  5. Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate test creation, refactoring, and automation workflows.
  6. Contribute to the overall testing strategy—framework enhancements, CI/CD integration, and test reliability improvements
  7. Investigate failures, troubleshoot issues across distributed systems, and ensure high-quality releases.
Qualifications
  1. 3+ years of experience as an SDET, QA Automation Engineer, or similar role.
  2. Strong proficiency in Playwright for test automation.
  3. Experience with Cypress and comfort migrating tests or frameworks.
  4. Solid understanding of modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
  5. Hands-on experience testing web applications and RESTful APIs.
  6. Familiarity with Next.Js, NestJS, or similar frameworks.
  7. Experience with AWS (Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, S3, etc.) is a plus.
  8. Comfortable using AI-enhanced development tools.
  9. Knowledge of CI/CD tools and building automated test pipelines.
  10. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a quality-first mindset.
Preferred / SDET-Level Expectations
  1. Experience with test design patterns and automation architecture.
  2. Familiarity with contract testing, mocking tools, or service virtualization.
  3. Understanding of performance or load testing frameworks.
  4. Experience in agile environments with cross-functional teams.

title: English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Especialista Em Chatbot & Conversão — Curadoria, Otimização E Escala (Whatsapp E Ia)
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ

Remoto

A ConCrédito é uma das maiores correspondentes bancárias do Brasil, especializada em crédito consignado nas modalidades CLT, INSS e FGTS. Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.

O Papel

O Especialista em Chatbot & Conversão será responsável por evoluir a jornada conversacional da empresa no WhatsApp, nosso principal canal de aquisição e conversão. Essa pessoa atuará na otimização contínua da experiência, reduzindo atritos, recuperando leads e aumentando a eficiência do funil por meio de automação, testes e uso de IA.

Responsabilidades

  • Mapear, analisar e otimizar a jornada conversacional de ponta a ponta no WhatsApp, identificando gargalos, fricções e oportunidades de melhoria nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Evoluir a arquitetura dos fluxos conversacionais com foco em experiência, engajamento, recuperação e conversão.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups, segmentações e estrutura de fluxo.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios, campanhas de reengajamento e estratégias de recuperação.
  • Trabalhar na personalização da jornada a partir de clusters de audiência, comportamento e contexto do cliente.
  • Apoiar a construção de dashboards e análises da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados, garantindo visibilidade dos principais indicadores de performance.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com Marketing, Vendas, BI, Operações e Produto/Tech para transformar insights em melhorias concretas na experiência e nos resultados.
  • Contribuir com o uso de IA e automação para escalar conversas com mais eficiência, relevância e capacidade de conversão.

KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida em Growth, CRO, Lifecycle, CRM, Produto ou áreas correlatas, com foco em conversão e evolução de jornada.
  • Vivência prática com canais conversacionais, especialmente WhatsApp, automação de mensagens e/ou chatbots.
  • Capacidade de mapear funis, identificar gargalos e transformar análise em ação.
  • Repertório em testes A/B, experimentação e otimização contínua de jornada.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada para acompanhar métricas de funil, cohort, LTV, CAC e performance por etapa.
  • Boa visão de experiência do cliente e comportamento em jornadas digitais.
  • Capacidade técnica para utilizar ou estruturar soluções com IA, agentes e automações aplicadas à conversão.
  • Boa comunicação e influência para atuar com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.

Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, crédito, cobrança, serviços financeiros ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Vivência com desenho de experiências conversacionais e arquitetura de fluxos.
  • Experiência em produto, CX ou gestão de jornadas digitais.
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Supabase, Metabase, Power BI ou ferramentas similares.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização, qualificação e conversão em canais conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.
  • Experiência com plataformas conversacionais como Blip, ColmeIA ou similares.

Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.

Job Title: Senior SAP Order to Cash (O2C) Consultant (Remote role)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Duration: 12 months (Possible extension)

Timing: 1st shift (Monday to Friday)

Job description:

We are seeking an experienced analyst with expertise in SAP Sales and Distribution processes, and a proven track record of working with SAP S/4, ECC and integration from legacy ERP systems. As a senior analyst of Sales and Distribution (SD), you will be responsible for supporting and optimizing technological solutions related to the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process within SAP environment. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, customer service, finance, manufacturing, logistics, and other IT units and 3rd party systems to support day-to-day operations successfully.

Responsibilities:

  • Sales & Distribution Support: Provide day-to-day functional and operational support for the end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) process in SAP S/4HANA & ECC SD, including sales documents, pricing, credit checks, availability checks (ATP), delivery processing, shipping, billing, output management and integration points with MM, WM, and FI.
  • Data Integrity & Integration Support Maintain and troubleshoot integration points between SAP and legacy or third-party systems, ensuring data accuracy and process continuity. Support and monitor data and process flows between SD and other modules (FI, MM, WM) and external systems (e.G., Logistics, EDI). Ensure that integration issues are quickly identified and resolved to avoid disruption in the O2C process.
  • Requirements & Enhancements Support: Partner with stakeholders to gather evolving business needs, assess change requests, translate them into functional requirements and work with technical teams. Provide ongoing support for enhancements, ensuring alignment with order to cash business processes.
  • Testing and Quality Assurance: Participate in regression testing, patch validations, and change impact assessments. Support user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles and maintain quality assurance practices for Sales & Distribution functionalities.
  • Support change management efforts by assisting with user training, maintaining training materials, and facilitating ongoing user adoption. Serve as a point of contact for end-user support and feedback, helping ensure a smooth transition and continued system optimization.

Required Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field. A master's degree or MBA is highly preferred.
  • 5+ years in IT, with a strong focus on technology solutions for order to cash and hands-on experience with SAP specifically in the areas of sales and distribution.
  • 2+ years of experience in S/4 HANA.
  • In-depth knowledge of the sales distribution processes within SAP, including sales order management, pricing, availability, delivery processing, billing, and invoicing.
  • Proven track record of experience in implementing and supporting SAP S/4 and ECC, specifically in the sales and distribution domain, including project planning, data migration, system configuration, and user training.
  • Proven experience supporting EDI integration within the SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) module, including troubleshooting IDoc processing, resolving interface errors, and coordinating with technical teams to ensure smooth electronic data exchange in the Order-to-Cash process.
  • Strong understanding of IT cloud-based solutions and emerging technologies relevant to OTC and SAP S/4.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization, including sales, customer service, logistics, and finance teams.
  • Proficiency in SAP S/4 modules relevant to Sales and Distribution (SD), and integration with other modules.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact senior Azure Cloud / DevOps role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is greenfield, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is highly selective and security‑conscious. You must operate with strong autonomy, deep hands‑on Azure expertise, and the ability to own cloud architecture end‑to‑end. The expectation is to design, build, operate, and evolve production systems directly.

You will work closely with VP‑level technical stakeholders in an environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential. This position requires someone who can challenge assumptions constructively, explain architectural tradeoffs clearly , and operate effectively in ambiguous, early‑stage environments.

  • Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months with the possibility of extension.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • 5+ years of hands‑on Azure architecture experience, including subscription and resource group strategies, identity and access control (RBAC, managed identities), and end-to-end ownership of production Azure environments.
  • Strong experience designing and operating Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, routing, private endpoints, and firewall concepts.
  • Hands‑on production experience with Azure PaaS services, including Azure App Services, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Front Door, and Azure Storage.
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and AKS operations , including cluster provisioning and upgrades, node pools, scaling strategies, networking integration (CNI, ingress), and workload isolation and security best practices.
  • Production-grade Terraform expertise, including modular design, environment separation, and state management with Azure backends.
  • Strong CI/CD automation experience integrating infrastructure as code and application deployments using Git-based pipelines.
  • Solid reliability engineering experience , including monitoring and alerting design, incident response and recovery, post-incident analysis, and the ability to reason about availability, scalability, cost optimization, and deployment safety.
  • Scripting ability using Bash and Python for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate infrastructure development, incident response, and documentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to operate confidently with VP-level stakeholders during architectural reviews and operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and own Azure cloud architecture for a greenfield PEG platform , including subscription structure, networking, identity, and environment separation.
  • Build and operate AKS-based workloads and supporting Azure PaaS services , ensuring high availability and operational resilience.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments, ensuring deployment safety and environment isolation.
  • Operate and evolve Terraform-driven infrastructure, maintaining modular design, clean state management, and consistent IaC practices across environments.
  • Design and maintain monitoring and alerting strategies across platform services, ensuring visibility into availability, performance, and reliability.
  • Lead troubleshooting and resolution of production issues, coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Improve platform reliability, automation, and developer experience through proactive runbook creation and operational documentation.
  • Partner with security and engineering stakeholders on network policies, access controls, private connectivity, and compliance requirements.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure, and cost-effective Azure architectures.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently during incidents and architectural reviews with VP-level technical stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Azure cloud engineering or DevOps roles, with end-to-end ownership of production environments.
  • Expertise operating Kubernetes/AKS workloads and Azure PaaS services in production contexts.
  • IaC background with Terraform , including environment separation and state management at scale.
  • Use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.

  • Atuar como Integration Analyst , apoiando iniciativas estratégicas de integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento em nuvem.

O que você precisa ter

title: Devops Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.

Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.

TL;
DR

You will helplead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.

This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:

"We can automate 80% of this."

And then actually build the automation.

What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.

Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.

Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.

Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.

Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.

What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.

Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

DevOps

  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Linux systems administration
  • Networking fundamentals

Automation

Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.

Languages

Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.

Why work with Quave

We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).

Pay and Benefits

This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

  • Fully remote work
  • Flexible hours
  • 22 days paid time off per year
  • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
  • AI allowance for productivity tools

We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.

Hiring Process

  1. Application review
  2. Technical conversation
  3. Architecture discussion
  4. Conversation(s) with one or more partners
  • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: Full-Time Social Ads Specialist
description:
About Us

BlueTuskr is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency specializing in e-commerce brands. As we continue to expand our paid advertising efforts across client accounts, we’re looking for a full-time Social Ads Specialist with strong technical (conversion tracking) and analytical skills, as well as proven client-facing experience. This role is 100% focused on paid social advertising — not SEO, not organic social.

What You’ll Do

As a Social Ads Specialist, you will manage a portfolio of social ad accounts for our clients, the majority of which are e-commerce sellers. You will be responsible for optimization, budgeting, monitoring, interpreting data and analytics, and clearly communicating campaign performance and strategy directly with clients. You will also stay current on new strategies, techniques, and processes that can improve campaign performance.

Platforms will primarily include Facebook and Instagram, with potential exposure to LinkedIn, Pinterest, and TikTok.

We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, analytical, demonstrates excellent written and verbal communication skills, and can confidently own both campaign performance and client relationships. This includes leading client calls, presenting performance insights, and acting as a strategic partner.

This role requires a strong understanding of post-iOS14 conversion strategies, audience targeting (lookalikes, custom audiences, interests, etc.), placements, and campaign structure. You must also be able to maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixel setup, event configuration, and event prioritization.

More specifically, in this role you will:

  • Execute and optimize paid social campaigns across multiple client accounts
  • Own client communication, including leading calls and presenting performance updates
  • Measure and report campaign performance against goals (ROI and KPIs)
  • Recommend, execute, and analyze testing strategies for clients
  • Strategize ways to improve overall campaign performance
  • Stay current on the latest paid ads trends and platform updates

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of proven experience managing paid social campaigns for e-commerce brands (especially Meta)
  • 2+ years of experience working within an agency environment (either in-house or servicing agency clients)
  • Proven client-facing experience, including leading calls and managing client relationships

What This Role Is NOT

This is not an SEO role, not organic social media management, and not content creation or community management. If your experience is not primarily in paid advertising, this role is not the right fit.

Time Commitment

Full-time. Remote. Ability to work during standard Eastern Time business hours is required.

Pay

$3,500–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience.

If you’re passionate about paid social advertising and know how to drive results for e-commerce brands, we look forward to hearing from you!

Have 1-4 years of experience building production React/Next.Js apps

Send your GitHub, LinkedIn, and 2-3 lines on the hardest frontend problem you’ve solved lately. Bonus: links to anything you’ve built that makes you proud.

We start with a take home task where you’ll be asked to identify bugs in a sample github repo and indicate how you would fix it.

Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .

The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.

This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.

The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.

Content & Provider Curation
